title: 双院模型：并行语言模型间的双向隐态耦合
summary: 提出双院模型，通过可训练的神经接口在中间隐态上耦合两个冻结的语言模型。主模型驱动任务，辅助模型操作工具，两者通过翻译网络和抑制门（约1%参数）相互调节。在算术、逻辑谜题和数学推理任务上显著提升性能。
summary_en: Proposes the Bicameral Model that couples two frozen language models via a trainable neural interface on intermediate hidden states. A primary model drives the task while an auxiliary model operates tools, with both conditioning on each other's activations. Achieves significant accuracy gains on arithmetic, logic puzzles, and mathematical reasoning.
